customManagers.description: Commit-pinned sources: `# renovate: ... currentValue=<branch>` above an `ARG <NAME>=<sha>`. Needed for repositories that publish no releases or tags at all (oh-my-zsh), where a commit is the only stable identifier and Renovate has to track the branch head as a digest
Version pins declared via `# renovate:`-annotated ARG lines in the Dockerfile (build2, doxygen, ...)
Documentation theme pinned in the site generator - the theme is not installed in any image, so it has no `ARG` in the Dockerfile to hang off

Base image declared as `ARG BASE_IMAGE=` in the Dockerfile - needs its own manager rather than the `# renovate:`-annotated one above, because a digest pin has to capture currentValue and currentDigest separately
